title: I made HISS IN BRICK — a prop hunt game where you can literally destroy your friends' hiding spots
author: BerryliciousMeghan
selftext:
You know those prop hunt players who glitch into walls or hide in spots where nobody can reach them?

In HISS IN BRICK, hunters can destroy the environment to get to you. Hiding inside something won't necessarily save you when they can just smash their way through.

No more untouchable hiding spots. 🐍

**As for AI in development:**

I used generative AI to help with coding, especially the voxel systems. When working with dynamic geometry without AI, even small logical errors can lead to disastrous results — geometry gets distorted, and holes appear in random places.

If you'd like to check out HISS IN BRICK, here's the Steam page:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5189800](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5189800)

comments.author: Individual_Review771
comments.body: if the entire snake turns to the exact same blocks used in the environment then where is the skill required for seekers? You will just be guessing compared to spotting

replies.author: BerryliciousMeghan
replies.body: We're going more for a classic Prop Hunt experience. In the original Garry's Mod Prop Hunt, players can blend into the environment with just one button press. Players need to keep moving to avoid getting caught, so we made the painting mechanic quick and easy to use. You can blend into your surroundings in just a few seconds.
